sections.title: Heartbreak, Death, and Sometimes a Rainbow:  Young Adults and Literature
sections.description: In this course, we will explore Young Adult Literature in depth to trace where adolescence and society cross, clash, mesh. We will read (and watch) across era and genre, exploring literature of the long adolescence through two-and-a-half centuries, prose narrative to graphic novel to forays into Instagram and TikTok. See the English Department's website at www.english.upenn.edu for a description of the current offerings.
